## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (for example `fix(media): ...`).
- [ ] A test failed first, then passed (`composer test`).
- [ ] `composer phpstan` and `composer phpcs` pass.
- [ ] New behavior that changes output is opt-in and off by default.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] README or docs are updated, if behavior changed.
